rows.definition: The STOP_UNWITNESSED signal string emitted when a session's stop carries no declared witness: gateway registers it as ReasonStopUnwitnessed (abi.ReasonCode 1070, named via ReasonStopUnwitnessedName, internal/gateway/stop_gate.go:10-15), stopgate returns it as the boundary decision reason/signal (internal/stopgate/boundary.go:214,281; internal/stopgate/witness.go:110), and the agent loop recognizes it to splice the continue-working continuation (internal/agent/loop_turn.go:588).
rows.distinction: A DENIAL SIGNAL naming why the stop was refused, not the block-budget counter that counts such refusals (WitnessBlockCount) and not the gate function that decides them (EvaluateWitness).

rows.definition: The UnwitnessedCount field (json unwitnessed_count) on looprecover's recovery result (internal/looprecover/looprecover.go:144): how many in-flight ledger runs had no completion witness when the loop crashed, so fak loop recover re-runs them alongside OrphanedCount (cmd/fak/loop_recover.go:103-123); conceptbench's agentic floor also projects it (internal/conceptbench/agentic_floor.go).
rows.distinction: A RECOVERY INPUT COUNT (runs to redo after a crash), not the recovery subsystem itself (looprecover) and not a dishonesty metric like ClaimUnwitnessedCount, which grades narrated-but-unwitnessed done claims.

rows.definition: Package-level atomic.Bool (internal/model/v41_bf16_publish.go:16) set true while the V4.1 host-side BF16 weight publish path has produced a witnessed binding; every V4.1 forward pass consults it before trusting host-published BF16 tensors (resident binding v41_bf16_resident_binding.go:152, compressor/index v41_compress_index.go:227, engram decode v41_engram_row_decode.go:28, norm bindings, KV/query norm bindings).
rows.distinction: A LIVE PUBLISH-STATE FLAG gating trust in host BF16 tensors at runtime, not a build-tag witness archive (v41_indexer_witness) and not a measured hardware witness receipt.

rows.definition: The cgo build tag v41_indexer_witness that switches the Vulkan compute backend onto the dedicated libfakvulkan_v41_indexer_witness native archive (internal/compute/vulkan.go:14 plus the matching #cgo LDFLAGS lines in vulkan_ops_vulkan.go, vulkan_glm_kda.go, vulkan_matmul_fused.go, vulkan_device_sync.go, vulkan_device_debug.go); computebuild receipts recognize its companion FAK_V41_INDEXER_SCORE_WITNESS env var (internal/computebuild/vulkan_receipt_successor.go:105).
rows.distinction: A BUILD TAG selecting which prebuilt native archive links the V4.1 indexer score, not a runtime witness flag (v41HostBF16Witness) and not the scoring backend interface itself (V41IndexerScoreBackend).

rows.definition: The WITNESS_UNWITNESSED_CLAIM member of observer's closed WitnessVerdict vocabulary (internal/observer/verdict.go:56): stamped on a mutating tool observation whose claimed effect produced no verifiable diff; screen.go fails it closed when RequireWitnessDiff is set (internal/observer/screen.go:228) and pool.go both stamps it and enforces it (internal/observer/pool.go:169,196,613).
rows.distinction: One of two CLOSED VERDICT VALUES (the other being WitnessDiffConfirmed) - a result label, not the vocabulary type itself (WitnessVerdict) and not a stop-gate denial signal (STOP_UNWITNESSED).

rows.definition: The closed string-vocabulary type for mutation evidence verification in internal/observer/verdict.go:52, with members WitnessDiffConfirmed / WitnessUnwitnessedClaim, strict parsing via ParseWitnessVerdict and membership via IsValid; carried on Observation.WitnessVerdict (json witness_verdict, verdict.go:112) and read back by metrics' trust-violation accounting (internal/metrics/trust_violation.go).
rows.distinction: The VOCABULARY TYPE plus its parse/validate helpers, not one of its member values (WitnessUnwitnessedClaim) and not a remote-DRAM witness state machine (RemoteDRAMWitnessVerdict).
